package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// LearningEvidence owns the idempotent student projection of curated learning facts.
type LearningEvidence interface {
	ApplyTeacherAssistance(ctx context.Context, assistance domain.TeacherAssistance) (bool, error)
}

// PracticeEvidence owns ingestion of immutable Practice runtime results. It is
// separate from teacher observations so consumers depend on the narrow port.
type PracticeEvidence interface {
	ApplyPracticeEvidence(ctx context.Context, evidence domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle) (bool, error)
}

// TargetMasteryReader returns the current student-owned projection for exact targets.
type TargetMasteryReader interface {
	ListStudentTargetMastery(ctx context.Context, studentID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error)
}
